    Eris

    📜 History & The Hybrian Origin¶

    ⏳ The Date of Creation¶

    • Official Church Canon: Claims the Erisian Church appeared around -300 BGD.
    • Scholarly Consensus: Academic tradition attributes the correct establishment to around 180~ AGD, backed by extensive archaeological findings discovered in the Valley of Kenn the Great.
    • The Historical Truth: The entire religion was actually a covert cult manufactured by a group of Hybrians around -400 BAC to act as a ideological facade.

    🗺️ Regions & Influence¶

    The Erisian faith has the outward aesthetic of a dominant global religion, but it remains heavily regionalized within the continent of Erisdar.

    • Territorial Reach: Prevalent across East Erisdar, half of North Erisdar, and half of West Erisdar.
    • The Central Hegemony: While dominant in Central Erisdar, the Church is far from absolute; numerous localized areas still worship competing religions. Other races completely avoid the Erisian cult.
    • Institutional Decline: The era of aggressive religious crusades and genocidal expansion began dying down around 500~ BCA. As the Church's institutions have cracked over time:
      • The Elven population has finally returned to stable levels.
      • Independent Elvish States have been allowed to re-establish themselves.
      • Strict internal dogmas, such as the universal laws forbidding polygamy, have begun to dwindle and fail in various localized parts of their territory.

    📖 The Myth of Eris (The Eris Saga)¶

    The centerpiece of the church's faith is a heroic tale compiled entirely in a sacred text called "The Eris Saga."
